reason: Tactical/duty pants are typically worn with a belt, and many law enforcement/military users need a duty/rigger or inner/outer belt system to support holsters, pouches, and other load-bearing gear. This is a practical same-job-function pairing that helps complete the uniform/kit.

Helmet accessories (face shields, goggles, helmet lights, nomex covers, chin straps) are directly used with fire/rescue helmets in the same operational context and are often required for protection, visibility, retention, or compliance. Customers purchasing a fire helmet commonly need at least one of these to complete the helmet setup or replace worn components.

Radio straps are a common required accessory for carrying/retaining portable radios in the field (law enforcement, fire/EMS, industrial safety). Customers buying radios often need a strap for hands-free use, quick access, and to prevent drops/loss.

Fire helmets are for firefighting/rescue operations, while gun magazines are law-enforcement/military firearm accessories. They are not used together in the same job function and a customer purchasing a fire helmet would not typically need gun magazines as a required or practical add-on.

Tactical/duty socks are a direct complementary item to tactical boots in the same job functions (law enforcement, military, industrial). Customers buying boots typically also need appropriate moisture-wicking, cushioned socks for comfort, blister prevention, and performance during long shifts.
